pull_requests.scope: Makes collection wrappers satisfy dict/Mapping isinstance tests outside lib, adds dynamic box dispatch and a program-wide DICTHINT recompilation pass, and disables Any-to-dict narrowing when a wrapper is boxed.
evidence: Reviewed static dict_class/dict_object checks, dynamic isdict dispatcher, global hint discovery and the additional Rejoin path.
Baseline docs and tests/deviations/lib_collections_mappings.py explicitly describe these wrappers as holding dictionaries rather than deriving from dict.
Current review thread PRRT_kwDOU_6QTs622qA3 is unresolved and not outdated at this exact head.

The review reports an executed new rejection: an unrelated Any=Counter('abc') makes a formerly accepted guarded dict.get(x, 'a', 0) reject. The source mechanism is corroborated by global DICTHINT, gen_dyn_narrow_type returning no refinement, and unchanged gen_unbound_call accepting a dynamic descriptor receiver only for list. This agent did not execute the reproduction.

concrete_review_finding.summary: Program-wide removal of dict refinement makes unrelated wrapper boxing reject supported ordinary-dictionary descriptor calls.

risks: The new global compiler pass creates inference coupling to unrelated boxing and has a demonstrated no-new-rejections violation.

Static-only extraction would still change branch selection for wrapper objects whose representation is not dict and could activate unsupported dict-only operations; it needs coherent descriptor/refinement coverage.
The source-location distinction for lib code preserves an intentional divergence; this is not a complete dict-subclass representation change.
pull_requests.release_rationale: This is correction of a disclosed compatibility limitation with a concrete new acceptance regression. It should not enter frozen RC.2.
